intervals.note: DECam remained in service after DES observing ended; the NOIRLab CTIO page says CTIO "operates the Víctor M. Blanco 4-meter Telescope on Cerro Tololo, which features the Dark Energy Camera (DECam)".
intervals.quote: Official “First Light” was on the night of September 12 (UT), 2012.

placements.quote: Official “First Light” was on the night of September 12 (UT), 2012.

summary.plain: A 570-megapixel digital camera mounted at the focus of the 4-metre Blanco telescope in Chile; built for the Dark Energy Survey and still in use.
summary.technical: DECam: 2.2-degree diameter field, 62 2k×4k imaging CCDs and 12 guide/focus CCDs, five-element corrector, seven filters, at the prime focus of the Blanco 4-m telescope.

technology.quote: The camera consists of a five element optical corrector, seven filters, a shutter with a 60 cm aperture, and a CCD focal plane of 250 micron thick fully-depleted CCDs cooled inside a vacuum Dewar.
technology.value: Wide-field optical/near-infrared CCD imager: 570-megapixel focal plane of fully depleted CCDs, five-element corrector, seven filters, at the Blanco prime focus.
